cases.name: Louise Marie Capul Lewis
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Louise was born on January 13, 1945 in Baltimore, Maryland one of nine children of Louis J. and Theresa (Pasquerell) Capul and worked as a waitress for Eat N Park Restaurants."
